pages.text: Wooden and upholstered seats both satisfy the required seat component. Fit exactly one, and add a cabinet beneath either style.$(br2)Standard and extended boxes accept one or two seats. Wide boxes also accept three. Three-seat benches are exclusive to wide boxes. Two-seat benches drive from the left; three-seat benches from the middle.

Board by clicking the $(bold)visible upper cushion or wooden seat surface$(reset). Backs, supports and obscured surfaces do not board. Riders need sufficient clearance.$(br2)Make a two-seat bench from matching single seats. Make a three-seat bench from three singles, or a double and a single, all of the same wood.

Both shaft types fit every box. Craft double-horse shafts from two single-horse sets. Both animals must be hitched to drive.$(br2)Shafts have no wood variants. Hitch choice sets the number of draft animals, rather than the wagon’s base speed.
